jobs.name: momentum_x1_momo_machine_clip
jobs.prompt: The blue sphere mascot looks up at the folded blue cardstock polyhedron beside it. The polyhedron slowly rotates a quarter turn on its base, gold beads catching the light, and settles. The mascot tilts its head, antenna bobbing with the yellow bead, then does one small excited hop and settles. Camera locked. Soft top-left light fixed, both shadows tracking. Cream cardstock still. Mascot proportions stay exactly constant. Ends with both at rest. No text, no faces.

jobs.name: momentum_x2_paper_city_clip
jobs.prompt: The folded blue cardstock museum stands still. The camera pushes in very slowly toward the roof, about fifteen percent over the shot, keeping the building centred. The small blue disc mascot on the roof blinks, then hops once and lands with a small wobble, its curly antenna bouncing, and looks toward camera. Soft studio key from the right fixed, long shadows steady. Cream cardstock sky still. Ends with the mascot at rest on the roof. No text, no faces, no people.

jobs.name: momentum_x3_the_fold_clip
jobs.prompt: Top-down on the row of folded blue cardstock pyramids joined by the gold cable. From left to right, one after another, each pyramid unfolds flat into an open triangle with springy paper momentum, then immediately folds back up into a pyramid and settles with a dampened overshoot, the gold beads turning as they go, the gold cable staying taut throughout. A wave of folding travelling along the row. Camera locked. Soft top-left light fixed, shadows changing shape with each fold. Ends with all six pyramids closed as they began. No text, no hands, no tools.

jobs.name: momentum_x4_page_writes_clip
jobs.prompt: Top-down on the paper phone card. The grey placeholder bars on its face fill in one row at a time from top to bottom, each bar extending from left to right like a line being written, with a snappy ease and a firm stop. When the last bar completes, the orange button at the top depresses once and pops back. Camera locked orthographic. Soft top-left light fixed, drop shadow steady. Beige paper still. No legible text ever appears, only bars. Ends still.

jobs.name: momentum_x5_particles_converge
jobs.prompt: Thousands of tiny glowing blue and gold particles drift in the dark with depth. Over the shot they are drawn inward, spiralling gently toward the centre, and tighten into a dense, perfectly circular ring at centre frame, the ring growing brighter and more defined as more particles arrive, a few gold ones sparkling as they settle. Near particles pass soft and large, far ones sharp and small. Camera locked, very slight slow push in. No shapes, no letters, no logo, no light rays. Deep navy-black field throughout. Ends with the ring dense, bright and still.

jobs.name: momentum_x5_particles_disperse
jobs.prompt: A dense circular ring of tiny glowing blue and gold particles hangs still in the dark. It holds for a beat, then the ring breaks apart from its centre outward, particles scattering in every direction with soft drift and depth, near ones passing large and soft, far ones sharp and small, thinning until only faint scattered specks remain drifting. Camera locked. No shapes, no letters, no logo, no light rays. Deep navy-black field throughout. Ends almost empty.

jobs.name: momentum_x6_particles_cream_converge
jobs.prompt: Thousands of tiny matte blue and gold paper specks lie scattered on cream cardstock. Over the shot they slide inward across the paper as if drawn by a magnet, gathering into a dense, perfectly circular ring at centre frame, each speck settling with a tiny bounce, the ring becoming denser and more defined as specks arrive. Soft top-left light fixed, tiny shadows tracking. Camera locked. No shapes, no letters, no logo. Cream paper throughout. Ends with the ring dense and still.
